brief: The canvas displays an intricate, interlocking tessellation of hexagons rendered in a vibrant 1980s color palette. These hexagons continuously rotate and shift, creating mesmerizing, evolving patterns. The visual core features color shifts across the tessellation, where the saturation of a hexagon is dynamically influenced by the rotational velocity of its neighbors. The pattern also features varied levels of perceived transparency and directional flow. The visual display is accompanied by a subtle, ambient soundtrack, and the entire structure is interactive, responding to mouse clicks to alter its configuration and movement.

statement: This sketch creates a mesmerizing, evolving tessellation of rotating hexagons that pulse and shift across the canvas in a vibrant 1980s color palette. Each hexagon rotates at its own velocity while subtly shifting position, creating an organic flow that responds to its neighbors' movements. The saturation of each hexagon dynamically changes based on the average rotational speed of nearby hexagons, creating visual feedback loops that make the pattern feel alive and interactive. The composition features varying levels of transparency and subtle directional movement that create depth and motion. A simple click interaction alters the rotation dynamics of all hexagons while triggering a subtle sound effect, making the entire experience both visually and auditorily engaging. The system maintains performance through careful management of shape calls and spatial relationships, ensuring smooth animation even with many elements on screen.
